description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter is about to be deprecated.

description.zh: 消费组ID，您可以调用[DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~)接口查询消费组ID。
description.en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call the [DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~) operation to query the consumer group ID.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用**DescribeSubscriptionInstances**接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the **DescribeSubscriptionInstances** operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts delete-consumer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsg2m10r1x15a0000 --consumer-group-id dtssb911ydd1920000 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DeleteConsumerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ConsumerGroupID dtssb911ydd1920000 --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SubscriptionInstanceId dtsg2m10r1x15a0000
